parameters.description:
`pushsafer-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushsafer` payload that includes your Pushsafer private or alias key (the `k` form field). The gateway forwards it to the upstream Pushsafer API, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
parameters.summary: Relay a push notification through your own Pushsafer account by posting a native Pushsafer payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
